title: kbmon's text view drops a panel's own reason: an absent coord store reads 'no mon_coord.py'
goal: the text view prints the reason a panel gives for a state other than ok (an absent store names the store, an unreachable server names the refusal), and says 'no mon_<name>.py' only when the module is missing

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
def k(*a,env=None):
    t0=time.time();p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env or os.environ,timeout=120);p.wall=time.time()-t0
    if p.returncode not in (0,1): print('kbmon exit',p.returncode,p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(1)
    return p
st=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'none.sqlite')
p=k('--once','--panel','coord','--store',st)
print(p.stdout[:300]);sys.exit(1 if 'no mon_coord.py' in p.stdout else 0)

notes: SP-5gph7fh6 review: the view's reason() ignores data.reason, so mon_coord's absent and timeout reasons are lost. The reviewer asked ST-q4qqiw2w g1 to change to BG-qpcct4ps's fix (a state in mon_base) with the view printing data.reason; fix the two together.
